<?php
/**
 * Secure API Gateway - Token Verification & Rate Limiting
 * Implements HMAC-based request authentication with replay protection
 */

class HMACVerifier {
    private $secretKeys;
    private $nonceStore;
    private $maxClockSkew = 300; // 5 minutes
    
    public function __construct(array $secretKeys, NonceStore $nonceStore) {
        $this->secretKeys = $secretKeys;
        $this->nonceStore = $nonceStore;
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify request authenticity using HMAC-SHA256
     * Checks: key existence, timestamp freshness, nonce uniqueness, signature validity
     */
    public function verifyRequest(array $headers, string $body): AuthResult {
        $authHeader = $headers['Authorization'] ?? '';
        $parsed = $this->parseAuthHeader($authHeader);
        if ($parsed === null) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'malformed_header');
        }
        
        // Validate key ID exists
        if (!isset($this->secretKeys[$parsed['keyId']])) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'unknown_key');
        }
        
        // Check timestamp freshness (replay protection layer 1)
        $requestTime = intval($parsed['timestamp']);
        $currentTime = time();
        if (abs($currentTime - $requestTime) > $this->maxClockSkew) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'stale_request');
        }
        
        // Check nonce uniqueness (replay protection layer 2)
        if ($this->nonceStore->exists($parsed['nonce'])) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'replay_detected');
        }
        
        // Construct canonical string for signature verification
        $canonical = $this->buildCanonicalString(
            $parsed['keyId'],
            $parsed['timestamp'],
            $parsed['nonce'],
            $body
        );
        
        // Compute expected signature
        $secret = $this->secretKeys[$parsed['keyId']];
        $expectedSig = $this->computeSignature($canonical, $secret);
        
        // Verify signature
        if (!$this->safeCompare($expectedSig, $parsed['signature'])) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'invalid_signature');
        }
        
        // Store nonce to prevent replay
        $this->nonceStore->store($parsed['nonce'], $requestTime + $this->maxClockSkew);
        
        return new AuthResult(true, 'verified', $parsed['keyId']);
    }
    
    private function parseAuthHeader(string $header): ?array {
        // Format: HMAC-SHA256 KeyId=xxx,Timestamp=xxx,Nonce=xxx,Signature=xxx
        if (strpos($header, 'HMAC-SHA256 ') !== 0) {
            return null;
        }
        $paramStr = substr($header, 12);
        $params = [];
        foreach (explode(',', $paramStr) as $pair) {
            $parts = explode('=', $pair, 2);
            if (count($parts) !== 2) return null;
            $params[trim($parts[0])] = trim($parts[1]);
        }
        
        $required = ['KeyId', 'Timestamp', 'Nonce', 'Signature'];
        foreach ($required as $key) {
            if (!isset($params[$key]) || strlen($params[$key]) === 0) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        
        // Validate nonce format: must be 32 hex characters
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/', $params['Nonce'])) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Validate timestamp is numeric
        if (!ctype_digit($params['Timestamp'])) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Validate KeyId format
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{1,64}$/', $params['KeyId'])) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return [
            'keyId' => $params['KeyId'],
            'timestamp' => $params['Timestamp'],
            'nonce' => $params['Nonce'],
            'signature' => $params['Signature']
        ];
    }
    
    private function buildCanonicalString(string $keyId, string $ts, string $nonce, string $body): string {
        $bodyHash = hash('sha256', $body);
        return implode('\n', [$keyId, $ts, $nonce, $bodyHash]);
    }
    
    private function computeSignature(string $data, string $secret): string {
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $data, $secret);
    }
    
    /**
     * Timing-safe comparison to prevent side-channel attacks.
     * Uses length check first to avoid processing on obviously wrong inputs.
     */
    private function safeCompare(string $expected, string $provided): bool {
        // Quick rejection for length mismatch
        if (strlen($expected) !== strlen($provided)) {
            return false;
        }
        // Use XOR-based comparison
        $result = 0;
        for ($i = 0; $i < strlen($expected); $i++) {
            $result |= ord($expected[$i]) ^ ord($provided[$i]);
        }
        return $result == 0;
    }
}

class RateLimiter {
    private $redis;
    private $windowSize = 60;
    private $maxRequests = 100;
    
    public function __construct($redis) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
    }
    
    public function checkLimit(string $keyId): bool {
        $window = floor(time() / $this->windowSize);
        $redisKey = "ratelimit:{$keyId}:{$window}";
        $current = $this->redis->incr($redisKey);
        if ($current === 1) {
            $this->redis->expire($redisKey, $this->windowSize * 2);
        }
        return $current <= $this->maxRequests;
    }
}

class AuthResult {
    public $authenticated;
    public $reason;
    public $keyId;
    
    public function __construct(bool $auth, string $reason, string $keyId = '') {
        $this->authenticated = $auth;
        $this->reason = $reason;
        $this->keyId = $keyId;
    }
}

interface NonceStore {
    public function exists(string $nonce): bool;
    public function store(string $nonce, int $expiry): void;
}

class RedisNonceStore implements NonceStore {
    private $redis;
    
    public function __construct($redis) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
    }
    
    public function exists(string $nonce): bool {
        return (bool)$this->redis->exists("nonce:{$nonce}");
    }
    
    public function store(string $nonce, int $expiry): void {
        $ttl = max(1, $expiry - time());
        $this->redis->setex("nonce:{$nonce}", $ttl, '1');
    }
}

// Gateway entry point
function handleApiRequest(array $config): void {
    $headers = getallheaders();
    $body = file_get_contents('php://input');
    
    $redis = new Redis();
    $redis->connect($config['redis_host'], $config['redis_port']);
    
    $nonceStore = new RedisNonceStore($redis);
    $verifier = new HMACVerifier($config['api_keys'], $nonceStore);
    $limiter = new RateLimiter($redis);
    
    $result = $verifier->verifyRequest($headers, $body);
    
    if (!$result->authenticated) {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode(['error' => $result->reason]);
        return;
    }
    
    if (!$limiter->checkLimit($result->keyId)) {
        http_response_code(429);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'rate_limit_exceeded']);
        return;
    }
    
    // Dispatch to backend
    http_response_code(200);
    echo json_encode(['status' => 'ok', 'key' => $result->keyId]);
}
